entities.name: Svyelun
entities.description: Goddess of the Pearl moon and patron of Dominaria's early merfolk empire of Vodalia; creator of the merfolk.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: Early merfolk empire of Dominaria, patroned by Svyelun.

entities.name: Society of the Conch
entities.description: Svyash caste group that travels seeking a closer understanding of Svyelun.

entities.name: Svyelunism
entities.description: Faith holding that mortals cannot approach the divine.

events.summary: Svyelun created the merfolk out of silt and seawater, per tradition.
events.quote: It was said that Svyelun had created the merfolk out of silt and seawater.

events.summary: Svyelun handed down her teachings in ancient times and has not communicated with mortals since.
events.quote: she handed down her teachings in ancient times and has not communicated with mortals since then

relations.quote: She is patron to Dominaria 's early merfolk empire of Vodalia

relations.note: Said to have created the merfolk.
